description: [DEEP] praxis-happiness-interests — Add hobby interest and log an event, verify last_event_date updates

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/praxis/happiness and wait for the page to load. The Happiness pillar page hosts the Interests tab.
Verify the Happiness page renders — either the Interests tab with a list of interests, or an empty state with an Add Interest CTA. Report what is shown. Take a screenshot.

POST /api/v1/hobbies with name=JH-Test-Hobby and category=Sport (capital S, required by enum). Verify 201 response with an interest_id. Then POST /api/v1/hobbies/{interest_id}/events with description='JH test event' and no event_date (server defaults to today). Verify 201 response. Then GET /api/v1/hobbies/{interest_id} and verify ALL three: (a) last_event_date is today's date (NOT null), (b) is_active is true, (c) dormancy_status is 'active' (not 'unknown' or 'dormant' — event just logged today).
Navigate back to https://app.phronex.com/praxis/happiness and verify the interest appears in the Interests tab list (or locate the Interests section). Take a screenshot.
Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/praxis and verify the dashboard loads without error. Data persists check complete.

description: [DEEP] praxis-skills-browse — browse skill templates and draft a new skill (approval/sandbox in separate test)

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/praxis/skills and wait for the page to load.
Verify the Skills page renders: either a list of skill templates, a list of user skills, or an empty state with a CTA to browse/add skills. Report what is shown. Take a screenshot.
POST /api/v1/skills/draft with name=JH-Test-Skill, description=A journeyhawk test skill. Verify 201 response with a skill_id and status=draft. Then GET /api/v1/skills/{skill_id} confirms draft state.
Navigate to /praxis/dashboard and back. Confirm no error boundary. The draft skill should still exist in GET /api/v1/skills/{skill_id}.

description: [DEEP] praxis-share-pillar — full token lifecycle: create (201), list, revoke (204), verify 410 Gone on revoked view, verify public view page accessible without auth

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-superadmin-state.json' using the browser storage state tool. Verify the session is active by checking no login prompt appears.

POST /api/v1/share/pillar/token with JSON body {"scope": "pillar:wealth", "ttl_seconds": 86400}. Verify: (a) HTTP 201 (not 200 — this was fixed in commit a7d6ae5), (b) response JSON contains token_id field. Record the token_id for subsequent steps.
GET /api/v1/share/pillar/token to list active tokens. Verify the newly created token_id appears in the list. Also verify each item has scope and expires_at fields.

Navigate in the SAME authenticated browser session to https://app.phronex.com/praxis/share/pillar/{token_id}. Verify the page loads (HTTP 200) and does NOT redirect to /auth/login. The page may show 'Pillar view not yet implemented' — this is acceptable Phase 43 WIP. The critical assertion is: no auth redirect.

DELETE /api/v1/share/pillar/token/{token_id} to revoke the token. Verify HTTP 204 (no body). Then GET /api/v1/share/pillar/{token_id}/view and verify HTTP 410 Gone (not 404) — this confirms revoked vs missing token distinction (fixed in commit a7d6ae5). Navigate back to dashboard.

description: [general] Tasks — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence + cross-service integration

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session or log in fresh
steps.action: Load session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-main-state.json'. If expired, navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login and log in with email qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com and password QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD.
steps.expected: User is authenticated and lands on the Praxis portal dashboard. No login error is shown. The sidebar is visible with labelled pillar groups including the 'Today' group containing Tasks.

steps.description: Navigate to the Tasks page
steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/tasks.
steps.expected: The Tasks page loads without errors. No blank page, no 'Something went wrong' error boundary, and no unhandled console errors. The task list or an empty state with an 'Add task' CTA is visible on screen.

steps.description: Verify Tasks page structure — list or empty state renders correctly
steps.action: Inspect the rendered Tasks page for either a task list (with at least one task card) or an empty-state message with an 'Add task' call-to-action button.
steps.expected: Either: (a) one or more task cards are visible with titles, due dates, and priority indicators, or (b) an empty-state UI is shown with a clearly labelled 'Add task' button — no blank or broken UI.

steps.description: Verify open tasks are reflected in the backend — GET /api/v1/work/tasks
steps.action: Open browser DevTools Network tab, then reload http://localhost:3002/praxis/tasks and observe the network request to GET /api/v1/work/tasks.
steps.expected: A request to GET /api/v1/work/tasks is made and returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array. Each item in the array represents an open task. The count and titles in the response match what is shown in the UI task list.

steps.description: Create a new task — click 'Add task'
steps.action: Click the 'Add task' button (CTA visible on the Tasks page).
steps.expected: A task creation form or modal opens. Input fields for at minimum: task title, due date, and priority are visible and interactive.

steps.description: Fill in new task details — title 'Draft Q3 review deck', due date 3 days out, priority High
steps.action: In the task creation form, enter title 'Draft Q3 review deck', set the due date to 3 days from today, and select priority 'High'. Then submit the form.
steps.expected: The form accepts all inputs without validation errors. On submission, the modal/form closes and the new task 'Draft Q3 review deck' appears in the task list with the correct due date and 'High' priority indicator. A success toast or confirmation message may appear.

steps.description: Verify new task is persisted via backend — GET /api/v1/work/tasks post-create
steps.action: After task creation, observe the network request to GET /api/v1/work/tasks (or trigger a reload and inspect the request).
steps.expected: GET /api/v1/work/tasks returns HTTP 200 and the response array includes the newly created task 'Draft Q3 review deck' with status open, due date 3 days out, and priority High.

steps.description: Edit an existing task — update the title of 'Draft Q3 review deck'
steps.action: Locate the task 'Draft Q3 review deck' in the task list. Click the edit action (pencil icon, context menu, or inline edit). Change the title to 'Draft Q3 Review Deck (Updated)' and save.
steps.expected: The task title updates to 'Draft Q3 Review Deck (Updated)' in the task list without a full page reload. A PATCH request to /api/v1/work/tasks/{task_id} is observed in the Network tab returning HTTP 200. No error messages are shown.

steps.description: Mark the task as complete — click 'Complete' on the updated task card
steps.action: Locate the task 'Draft Q3 Review Deck (Updated)' in the open task list. Click the 'Complete' button or checkbox on its card.
steps.expected: A POST request to /api/v1/work/tasks/{task_id}/complete is made and returns HTTP 200. The task is immediately removed from the open task list in the UI. A success indicator (toast, animation, or visual feedback) confirms the completion.

steps.description: Verify completed task no longer appears in open tasks list
steps.action: Inspect the current task list on the page and observe the GET /api/v1/work/tasks response in the Network tab.
steps.expected: The task 'Draft Q3 Review Deck (Updated)' is absent from the visible open task list and is not present in the GET /api/v1/work/tasks response array. No stale data is shown.

steps.description: Verify planning hierarchy reflects updated task counts — GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy
steps.action: Navigate to the Plan view (http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan) or observe a Network request to GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy triggered after task completion.
steps.expected: GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy returns HTTP 200. The task counts at the parent project level within the hierarchy reflect the completion of the task (i.e. the completed count has incremented or open count has decremented relative to pre-completion state).

steps.description: Navigate away and return — verify state persistence
steps.action: Navigate away from /praxis/tasks to the dashboard (e.g. http://localhost:3002/praxis/dashboard or the root portal URL). Then navigate back to http://localhost:3002/praxis/tasks.
steps.expected: The Tasks page reloads without errors. The task list reflects the current backend state (completed task absent, any remaining open tasks present). No stale or phantom tasks from the previous session are shown. The sidebar navigation correctly highlights the Tasks tab as active.

steps.description: Verify Tasks tab is reachable from the sidebar navigation
steps.action: From any page within the Praxis portal, locate the 'Today' group in the sidebar and click the 'Tasks' tab link.
steps.expected: The user is navigated to /praxis/tasks. The Tasks tab is highlighted/active in the sidebar. The page renders correctly with the task list or empty state — no redirect to login, no 404, and no error boundary.

steps.description: Verify no console errors or broken network requests throughout the journey
steps.action: Review the browser DevTools Console and Network tabs for any unhandled JavaScript errors, failed XHR/fetch requests (4xx or 5xx), or React error boundaries triggered during the entire journey.
steps.expected: Zero unhandled JavaScript errors in the console. All API requests to /api/v1/work/* return 2xx status codes. No React error boundaries are triggered. Any non-critical warnings are acceptable but must not affect functionality.

description: [general] Plan — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence + cross-service integration

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session or log in if session expired.
steps.action: Load session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-main-state.json'; if session is expired or missing, navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login and log in with email qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com and password QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD.
steps.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the Praxis dashboard (e.g. http://localhost:3002/praxis or equivalent landing route). The sidebar is visible with pillar groups (Today, Health, Work, etc.) and no authentication error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the Plan page under the Today pillar group.
steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan.
steps.expected: The Plan page loads without errors. No blank page, no 'Something went wrong' boundary, and no unhandled console errors. The page heading or tab title reflects 'Plan'. The sidebar highlights 'Plan' as the active item within the Today group.

steps.description: Verify the planning hierarchy is rendered on the Plan page.
steps.action: On http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan, observe the page content after it fully loads (wait for any loading spinners to resolve).
steps.expected: The page displays a planning hierarchy view. At least one level of hierarchy (vision, objectives, projects, or tasks) is visible. The list is not empty unless the test account genuinely has no data, in which case an empty-state message (e.g. 'No items yet' or similar) is shown rather than a blank or broken layout.

steps.description: Verify the GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy endpoint is called and returns a valid response.
steps.action: Open browser DevTools Network tab, reload http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan, and inspect the network request to /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy.
steps.expected: A GET request to /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy is made and returns HTTP 200. The response body is a JSON object or array representing the hierarchy (vision → objectives → projects → tasks). No 4xx or 5xx response codes appear.

steps.description: Navigate to the Tasks tab to create a new task (prerequisite for plan hierarchy cross-check).
steps.action: Click the 'Tasks' item in the sidebar (under the Today group) to navigate to the Tasks view.
steps.expected: The Tasks page loads at a URL containing /tasks or equivalent. The page renders a task list (or empty-state if no tasks exist). No error boundary or blank screen is shown.

steps.description: Create a new task via the Tasks UI.
steps.action: Click 'Add task' (or equivalent CTA button) on the Tasks page. In the form or modal that appears, enter title 'Draft Q3 review deck', set due date to 3 days from today, set priority to 'High', then submit the form.
steps.expected: The form submits successfully (POST /api/v1/work/tasks or equivalent returns 200/201). The new task 'Draft Q3 review deck' appears in the open tasks list with priority 'High' and the correct due date. A success toast or confirmation message may appear. No error is shown.

steps.description: Verify the newly created task is reflected in the planning hierarchy.
steps.action: Navigate back to http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan and observe the hierarchy view after it reloads.
steps.expected: The planning hierarchy reflects the updated task counts at the appropriate level. The task 'Draft Q3 review deck' is either directly visible or its parent project/objective shows an updated task count consistent with its addition. GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy returns updated data.

steps.description: Mark the newly created task as complete.
steps.action: Navigate back to the Tasks tab. Locate the 'Draft Q3 review deck' task card and click the 'Complete' button (or equivalent completion action) on it.
steps.expected: POST /api/v1/work/tasks/{task_id}/complete returns HTTP 200. The task 'Draft Q3 review deck' is removed from the open tasks list. A success toast or visual confirmation may appear. No error message is shown.

steps.description: Verify plan hierarchy updates after task completion.
steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan and observe the planning hierarchy.
steps.expected: The planning hierarchy reflects the task completion. Task counts at the relevant hierarchy level are decremented by 1 compared to step 7. GET /api/v1/work/planning-hierarchy returns data consistent with the completed task no longer being open.

steps.description: Test navigation persistence: navigate away from /praxis/plan and return.
steps.action: From http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan, click on a different sidebar item (e.g. 'Dashboard' or 'Calendar') to navigate away, then click 'Plan' in the sidebar to return to http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan.
steps.expected: The Plan page reloads without errors. Previously visible hierarchy data is re-fetched and displayed correctly. No stale or broken state is shown. The sidebar correctly re-highlights 'Plan' as active. No console errors or network failures appear.

steps.description: Verify the Plan page is accessible only to authenticated users (session guard).
steps.action: Open a new incognito/private browser window and navigate directly to http://localhost:3002/praxis/plan without logging in.
steps.expected: The user is redirected to the login page (http://localhost:3002/auth/login or equivalent). The Plan page content is not accessible without authentication. No sensitive data is exposed to unauthenticated users.

description: [general] Family — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence + cross-service integration

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session or log in if expired.
steps.action: Load session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-main-state.json'; if expired, navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login and sign in with email qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com and password QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD.
steps.expected: User is authenticated and lands on the Praxis dashboard (URL is http://localhost:3002/praxis or similar); no login redirect occurs.

steps.description: Navigate to the Family tab.
steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/family.
steps.expected: Page loads without errors. No blank page, no 'Something went wrong' error boundary, no console errors. The Family section heading or 'Add child' affordance is visible.

steps.description: Verify empty state before any child exists.
steps.action: Observe the Family page with no children added yet.
steps.expected: An empty state message or placeholder (e.g. 'No children added yet' or similar) is displayed. The 'Add child' button or control is visible and enabled.

steps.description: Open the Add Child form.
steps.action: Click the 'Add child' button on the Family page.
steps.expected: A form, modal, or drawer opens containing at minimum a 'Name' field and a 'Date of birth' field. A submit/save button is visible.

steps.description: Submit the Add Child form with valid data (PX-O-FAM-01).
steps.action: Enter name 'Test Child' in the name field. Enter a date of birth exactly 5 years before today's date (2021-05-16) in the date of birth field. Click the Save / Submit button.
steps.expected: The form submits successfully. POST /api/v1/children/ returns 201. A success toast or confirmation message appears. The new child card for 'Test Child' appears in the Family tab with a computed developmental stage label and the entered date of birth.

steps.description: Verify the child list includes the newly created child (GET /api/v1/children/).
steps.action: Observe the Family page after the successful save.
steps.expected: The child card for 'Test Child' is present. The card displays at minimum: the child's name, their date of birth or age, and a developmental stage label derived from the months-to-stage mapping.

steps.description: Verify computed developmental stage via child detail (GET /api/v1/children/{child_id}).
steps.action: Click on the 'Test Child' card or navigate to the child detail view.
steps.expected: The detail view loads without error. The child's profile includes a computed developmental stage field (e.g. 'Preschool', 'Early Childhood', or equivalent stage label). The DOB and name match what was entered.

steps.description: Edit the child profile (PATCH /api/v1/children/{child_id}).
steps.action: Click the Edit button on the 'Test Child' detail or card. Update the name to 'Test Child Updated'. Save the changes.
steps.expected: The form submits successfully. PATCH /api/v1/children/{child_id} returns 200. The child card or detail view now displays 'Test Child Updated'. No stale data or error message is shown.

steps.description: Upload a school document for the child (POST /api/v1/children/{child_id}/school-docs).
steps.action: Open the 'Test Child Updated' detail view. Locate the school documents section. Click the upload button and attach a small valid PDF or image file.
steps.expected: The upload completes. POST /api/v1/children/{child_id}/school-docs returns 201 or 200. The uploaded document appears in the school documents list for 'Test Child Updated'.

steps.description: List school documents for the child (GET /api/v1/children/{child_id}/school-docs).
steps.action: Observe the school documents section of the 'Test Child Updated' detail view after upload.
steps.expected: At least one document entry is visible in the list. The document name or filename is displayed. No error state or empty list is shown.

steps.description: Delete the uploaded school document (DELETE /api/v1/children/{child_id}/school-docs/{doc_id}).
steps.action: Click the delete or remove icon next to the uploaded school document. Confirm the deletion if a confirmation prompt appears.
steps.expected: The document is removed from the list. A success toast or visual confirmation is shown. The school documents section returns to an empty or placeholder state.

steps.description: Validation — attempt to add a child with an empty name.
steps.action: Click 'Add child'. Leave the name field blank. Enter a valid date of birth. Click Save.
steps.expected: The form does not submit. An inline validation error is shown on the name field (e.g. 'Name is required'). No POST request is fired. The form remains open.

steps.description: Validation — attempt to add a child with a future date of birth.
steps.action: Click 'Add child'. Enter name 'Future Child'. Enter a date of birth one year in the future (2027-05-16). Click Save.
steps.expected: The form does not submit or the API returns an error. A validation message is displayed indicating the date of birth cannot be in the future. No child card is added to the list.

steps.description: Delete the child profile (DELETE /api/v1/children/{child_id}).
steps.action: On the 'Test Child Updated' card or detail view, click the Delete button. Confirm the deletion when prompted.
steps.expected: DELETE /api/v1/children/{child_id} returns 200 or 204. The child card for 'Test Child Updated' is removed from the Family page. A success toast or confirmation is shown.

steps.description: Verify empty state is restored after deletion.
steps.action: Observe the Family page after deleting the only child.
steps.expected: The empty state message or placeholder reappears. No child cards are visible. The 'Add child' button remains accessible.

steps.description: Persistence check — navigate away and return to Family.
steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/dashboard (or any other Praxis tab). Then navigate back to http://localhost:3002/praxis/family.
steps.expected: The Family page reloads correctly without errors. The page reflects the current persisted state (empty state if no children, or child cards if children exist). No stale or corrupted data is shown.

steps.description: Verify Family tab appears in the correct sidebar pillar group.
steps.action: Observe the Praxis sidebar navigation layout on the Family page.
steps.expected: The Family tab is visible in the sidebar. It is grouped with other related People-domain tabs (e.g. People / PX-O-PPL-01 area). The sidebar renders without layout errors.
